title.zh: 锻造｜以锤炼之骨，造就一重新生
title.en: Forging | Tempered by the Hammer, Reborn Anew

summary.zh: 文章围绕轴承内外圈锻造工艺，解释为何不直接从整块钢材车削，而要经过加热、冲压、扩孔等工序，并介绍锻造对材料组织、强度和后续加工的意义。
summary.en: The article explains why bearing rings are forged instead of machined directly from a solid steel block, covering heating, punching and ring expansion and their effects on material structure, strength and downstream machining.
